title: Multi-Turn Sovereign Local Agent Execution & Autonomous Scratchpad Planning via MLX
target_platform: Apple Silicon M1 (16GB Unified Memory) via Apple MLX
hypothesis: Autonomous multi-step loops (plan -> dispatch tool -> receive tool observation -> reflect -> emit final result) can execute completely offline on Apple Silicon unified memory using Qwen2.5-Coder-7B with <= 3 turns per task, achieving >= 85% completion rate on bounded repository discovery workflows without cloud API reliance.
falsification_criteria: Local multi-turn agent degrades into repetitive infinite loops (> 4 identical tool dispatches), exceeds context cache limits, or completes < 75% of bounded inspection tasks.

model_routing.frontier_escalation_condition: Escalate to Gemini Flash or Claude Haiku if local multi-turn loop detects repetitive deadlock after 3 iterations

evidence.details: Frozen local_agent_loop.py on Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-4bit/MLX, 30 generated held-out tasks per run, exact-match grading, temp 0, max 5 turns. Run 4 (seed 1337): 25/30=83.3% (inconclusive band). Run 5 (seed 2024, after search_text fix): 22/30=73.3% < 75% pre-registered falsification line. Combined 47/60=78.3%, never reaching the 85% claim. By tier: scalar 100%, dirset 80-90%, locate 40-60%. No repetition falsification, no context overflow (max 3050 prompt tokens). Unassisted-correct 70-77%; only 63% correct within 3 turns; 6-7 of 30 tasks needed the forced final turn. Earlier runs 1-2 (5 hand tasks, 1/5 then 4/5 after tuning on the test set) are recorded as non-evidence.

lessons_learned: Local 7B loop is reliable for single-hop reads (scalar 100%) and mostly for directory listings, but fails multi-hop locate tasks (40-60%): it repeats a first wasteful glob, mis-targets search_text with glob paths, and ignores error hints.
Scaffolding (repeat suppression, forced final turn, error observations) is load-bearing; report unassisted-correct next to accuracy.

Loop-health signals flag 19/60 tasks and catch 10/13 failures but miss silent confident errors (letter-filtered directory lists); needs a verifier (MISSION-007) and an escalation policy (MISSION-028).
Tool error hints can mislead small models: 'use find_files' sent the model back to the glob; hints should show the corrected call. Fix requires a new frozen harness and fresh held-out run.
MLX server strips the <tool_call> special token; parse bare JSON calls.
